# Support

Read the README setup, current architecture and known limitations first. Open a GitHub issue for reproducible bugs or questions; include macOS version, Mac architecture, Node version, selected local profiles and redacted logs. Use synthetic materials and describe which checks you ran.

This is volunteer-maintained experimental software with no support SLA. Natural speech, model portability, accessibility and independent presentation quality still need work. For vulnerabilities, use SECURITY.md rather than public issues.
